title: KMIPKit Public API Manifest
description: Version 2 describes the complete KMIPKit 1.0 public API. The registry-slice branch remains for generator fixture compatibility.

requirementId.description: Stable functional or success-criteria identifier from an approved KMIPKit feature specification.

requirementIds.description: Requirement identifiers are unique and lexicographically sorted.

values.description: Known symbolic names and numeric codes in deterministic declaration order. Each code fits the declared unsigned C storage type. The generator also checks that names and codes are individually unique. The shape and unknownValuePolicy jointly state whether unknown codes are preserved or rejected.

enumRepresentation.description: A numeric enum with an explicit list of known values and a policy matched to its open or closed shape.

visibility.description: Whether this C representation is part of the supported public ABI or retained only for private in-repository FFI calls.

versioned.description: Whether the public fixed-width structure begins with uint32_t struct_size and uint32_t abi_version fields.

fields.description: The complete ordered C field layout for a public fixed-width ABI value.

type.description: A fixed-width scalar or KMIPKit typedef, optionally as a pointer. No arbitrary C declarators are accepted.

versioned.description: Whether the layout starts with uint32_t struct_size and uint32_t abi_version fields.

errorCategoryIds.description: Each identifier must resolve to one errorCategories entry.

cCode.description: Stable C error-code name; status values use int32_t.

cValue.description: Explicit stable numeric value for the named int32_t C error code.

cCode.description: Stable C error-code name; status values use int32_t.

cValue.description: Explicit stable numeric value for the named int32_t C error code.

mappingState.description: Whether the full error category mapping is ready across languages.

stableCHeaderCode.description: Keep a previously exposed stable C error code in the generated header while cross-language parity mapping is blocked.

oneOf.description: Borrowed pointer to a caller-owned fixed-width C value that does not carry embedded size and ABI-version fields.

type.description: Pointer to a generated fixed-width versioned public value structure.
Borrowed pointer to a caller-owned array of fixed-width scalar or byte-span carrier values.

countParameter.description: Name of the uint64_t scalar parameter that counts array elements.

nullable.description: Whether the array pointer may be NULL. When true, NULL is valid only when the linked count is zero; implementations must check the count before reading elements.

type.description: Pointer-to-pointer array of opaque C handles.

handleType.description: Opaque handle type of each array element; must match the declared pointer type.

countParameter.description: Name of the uint64_t scalar parameter that counts array elements.

nullable.description: Whether the array pointer may be NULL. When true, NULL is valid only when the linked count is zero; implementations must check the count before reading elements.

oneOf.description: Owned optional handle returned only when response-shape validation fails after a complete generic TTLV response was received. The slot is initialized to NULL and remains NULL for success and all other failures.

type.description: Pointer to one fixed-width integer result; not nullable.

nullable.description: Whether successful status may return no handle. Required explicitly for every output handle.

maxBytes.description: Maximum accepted input length in bytes when this span has a fixed bound.

requestBoundary.description: States how the function relates to typed requests. Generic TTLV and raw bodies never cross the execute boundary.

parameters.description: Rust parameter names and types, in declaration order.

documentation.description: Optional C API documentation lines rendered as a block comment before the requirement references.

parameters.description: Parameter order is the exact C ABI order. Variable-length byte inputs are byte-span pointers paired with uint64_t byte lengths; output arrays require an explicit fixed-width element type, caller capacity, and returned element count.

returnType.description: Every exported function returns a fixed-width status code; values and handles are written through explicit output parameters.

parameters.description: Java parameter names and types, in declaration order.

jniSymbol.description: Present only when this public Java method directly maps to a JNI entry point.

jniAggregateSymbol.description: Names the aggregate JNI entry point that returns this mapped value alongside other fields; the accessor has no direct JNI entry point.

parameters.description: Python parameter names and types, in declaration order.

ordering.description: For repeatable request extension attachment, declare preservation of caller-selected batch and extension order. For response extension access, declare preservation of the server-provided response extension order.

parameters.description: Exact C ABI parameter order for a declaration-level symbol.

returnType.description: Fixed-width status code or void for a direct lifecycle export.

documentation.description: Optional C API documentation lines rendered above the declaration.

defaultDiagnostics.description: Logs, errors, and default debug/display representations exclude extension payloads and secrets. Do not include sample payloads in manifest text.

zeroization.description: Describe KMIPKit-owned secret-memory cleanup without including secret values.

generatedOutputs.description: The generator writes only these source and test destinations, in the property order above. Documentation remains handwritten under the plan's docs/ and language-package docs.

rustType.description: Rust type subset: identifier paths, one- or two-level generic applications with non-empty path arguments, Result<(), E> including a qualified Result path, unit and tuple types, fixed arrays, references, borrowed slices, raw pointers, mutable pointer-to-pointer output slots for reviewed C ABI declarations, and higher-ranked StructureView callbacks used for explicit TTLV inspection.

javaType.description: Java parameter/type subset: primitive/simple or dot-qualified names, arrays, and one-level generic applications with non-empty reference-type arguments, including array types. Nested reference generics are accepted for typed collection results. Primitive and void generic arguments and wildcards are unsupported.

javaReturnType.description: Java method result type: a javaType or void.

pythonType.description: Python 3 type subset: simple or dotted names, one-level subscripted generics (including tuple ellipsis), and PEP 604 unions.

cSignature.description: Exact C ABI signature when this symbol is not a high-level function record.

cValue.description: Explicit fixed-width unsigned value for a generated C macro.

cValueType.description: Fixed-width C cast type for cValue.

javaSignatures.description: Exact javap signatures for an overloaded Java export path.

mappingSemantics.description: Declares the lifecycle semantics of the public declaration identified by packageId. Cross-language mapping names identify equivalent capability entry points and may have different ownership and cleanup behavior. Secret-buffer-wipe means this declaration wipes KMIPKit-owned secret-bearing storage at its own cleanup boundary.

lifecycleSemanticsByLanguage.description: Optional per-language cleanup behavior for cross-language lifecycle mappings where equivalent operations have different ownership boundaries.

cType.description: Optional C-only ABI carrier layout retained in the generated header without declaring a four-language facade type.

cFunction.description: Exact C prototype for a symbol whose idiomatic Rust, Java, or Python surface is represented through another declaration shape.

limits.description: The twelve ExtensionRegistryLimits entries have fixed names, defaults, maxima, and order from FR-012. Each language maps the same logical limit to its declared field name.

formatVersion.description: The manifest data format version. Breaking field or meaning changes require a new version and schema identifier.

scope.description: This manifest covers the KMIPKIT-0012 registry surface only; it is not the complete KMIPKit 1.0 API inventory.

types.description: Type declarations are emitted in this array order.

functions.description: Function declarations and each function's parameters are emitted in their declared array order.

errorCategories.description: Stable cross-language error mappings. Entries are emitted in this array order.

limits.description: The twelve ExtensionRegistryLimits entries have fixed names, defaults, maxima, and order from FR-012. Each language maps the same logical limit to its declared field name.
